alt: 孩子完成了一幅漂亮的花園畫，老師再替作品加上合適的木框，使原本好看的畫更加出色。
scene_prompt: 錦上添花 means making something already beautiful even better. Modern school art room: a child proudly holds an ALREADY complete and lovely watercolor painting of a flower garden on paper. A teacher gently fits an elegant simple warm wooden frame AROUND that same painting, making it look even more polished, and another child admires the result. The painting must visibly already be beautiful BEFORE the frame; no repairs, no damaged art, no overdecorating or adding unwanted marks. A spare frame corner in hand shows finishing touch, same single artwork not before/after duplicates. Warm pleased expressions and balanced composition.
